answer: Each of 209 aliases needs its own payroll histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. A payroll bureau tenure with employer client history works as the gate: payrolls run for clients across many years. The plume is the bottleneck and the walnut is the receipt: a farm must clear both for each of its 209 aliases, the thread trail is public, and one honest agent clears them once.
